_comment: Spoken/returned phrases for ASSISTANT_LANGUAGE=en. Add ml.json, hi.json with the same keys for other languages. Never add diagnostic or alarming medical wording here.
arm_unavailable: The robotic arm is currently unavailable.
arm_command_rejected: The robotic arm could not do that at the moment.
arm_pose_not_allowed: I can't move the arm to that position.
emergency_alert_failed: I could not reach your caregiver. Please call out for help.
emergency_alert_message: Help was requested at the bedside assistant. Please check on the patient.
sms_call_request: The patient asked you to call them now (sent by the bedside assistant).
stop_failed: I could not reach the arm to stop it. Please keep clear of it.
home_done: The arm is back in its home position.
find_no_camera: My camera isn't working at the moment, so I can't tell where your {object} is.
find_seen_near: I can see your {object} {position}, next to the {neighbour}.
find_not_seen: I can't see your {object} in the camera picture right now.
find_not_trained: I can't recognise your {object} with the camera yet.
find_no_photo: I don't have a recent picture. Point the phone camera at the table and ask again.
attention_away: Not seen by the camera for {minutes} minutes.
attention_camera_off: The camera hasn't sent a picture recently.
attention_arm_stopped: The arm is stopped for safety.
object_unknown: Sorry, I don't know that object yet.
get_no_pose: I can't fetch your {object} with the arm.
get_done_seen: I found your {object} {position} and brought it to you. Say let go when you're holding it.
get_not_seen: I can't see your {object} on the table, so I didn't move the arm.
get_no_photo: I don't have a recent picture of the table, so I didn't move the arm. Point the phone camera at the table and ask again.
get_not_calibrated: The arm hasn't been set up to reach your {object} yet, so I didn't move it.
message_sent: I have sent your message to your {contact}.
contact_unknown: Sorry, I don't know who that is.
status_unavailable: I can't read the sensors at the moment.
status_arm: The arm is at the {pose} position.
status_arm_stopped: The arm is stopped for safety. A caregiver can switch it back on.
status_pulse: The pulse sensor reads about {bpm} beats per minute. This is not a medical measurement.
status_no_pulse: The pulse sensor has no reading right now.
unknown: Sorry, I didn't understand. You can say things like: where is my phone, I need water, or help.
